lore_notes.fact: Claims to wake up some nights encased in a single massive scab cocoon, which is why he no longer shares a bed with his wife.
Says he does not control the 'health strength' from his weighted-log conditioning and still suffers unexplained bruises.
Owns a dog she brings to the studio; the dog eats chips neatly off the floor.
Has a cousin, ASMR Shuttle Raccoon, who hosts In Circeled in his absence.
Debuted the 'rippling' sex-hack segment and introduced recurring bit character Dr. Jiggle (vibrator head).

episode_summary: Barely Informed News covered escalating Israeli-Iranian energy infrastructure strikes and a live-TV bear encounter in Monrovia before Kendelle derailed the rundown with reality-TV gossip. Ben Hooper's odd-news minute triggered a surreal Hype Train freestyle confession, while Crum's continued evasion of the gorilla dick punch spawned new body-horror lore. The broadcast closed with a furry-authenticity tribunal, DJ Newsic's explicit 'rippling' anthem, and a raid to Bruce Green.
